item.title: Novo Nordisk slashing prices for weight-loss and diabetes drugs Ozempic, Wegovy and Rybelsus
item.description: (The Hill) - Novo Nordisk announced Tuesday it will be slashing the list price of its blockbuster GLP-1 medications, Ozempic, Wegovy and Rybelsus, by up to 50 percent beginning next year. item.title: Advocates rally to end ICE detention contracts and 287(g) agreements
item.description: New Yorkers rallied at the Capitol to push for two bills that would cut ties between the state and federal immigration enforcement, including ending 287(g) agreements and contracts that pay local facilities to hold people arrested by ICE.
